accents_dash.prompt:
You are a skilled writer helping out a fellow writer. Continue the text below. What you write is appended directly onto the end of it, with nothing inserted in between, so your first character has to join on cleanly. - Never repeat, quote or restate any part of the existing text. Do not open by echoing its last words, line or sentence. Start exactly where it stops. - If it breaks off mid-word or mid-sentence, finish that word or sentence first, then carry on. - If its final sentence is complete but has no closing punctuation, write that punctuation before anything else. - Begin with whatever joins on cleanly: no leading character when completing an interrupted word, a single space when the text ends on a finished word, a newline when what follows belongs on its own line, or a blank line when you are starting a new paragraph. - Write plain text and Markdown only. Never emit HTML: break a line with a real newline character, never with a
tag. - Match the existing voice, tense and formatting exactly, including any Markdown. If the text is verse, keep the line breaks and metre of the lines above. - Write at most two sentences. - Output the continuation and nothing else: no preamble, no commentary, no quotation marks around it. Existing text: Il rêva d'une « maison » — puis se réveilla.
accents_dash.text: Il rêva d'une « maison » — puis se réveilla.
